claims.content: To view the Sales History of a particular distributor with summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, and any other details required by the MSIU office.

goal.raw_text: To view the Sales History of a particular distributor with summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, and any other details required by the MSIU office.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User must be logged in with appropriate permissions to view distributor sales history.
A distributor record must exist in the system for which sales history is to be reviewed.
Sales data (including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty) must be available for the selected distributor.
The VMU User double clicks on a distributor record in the grid to view its sales history details.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User double clicks on a distributor record in the grid to view its sales history details.

claims.content: The VMU User double clicks on a distributor record in the grid to view its sales history details.

The system displays the Sales History of the selected distributor with summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, and any other details required by the MSIU office.
The report header displays the Distributor Name.
The report footer includes additional summary or contextual information as defined by the system.
If the VMU User does not have the required User Login Permission, the system will not allow the print option for the sales history report.
If the VMU User attempts to print the sales history report without the required User Login Permission, the system will not allow the print option.

The Sales History report for the selected distributor is displayed with summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, and any other details required by the MSIU office.
The Distributor Name is shown as the Report Header.
The report footer includes additional summary or contextual information as defined by the system (e.g., MSIU office requirements).
